## Intro

This week's most relevant change for tachograph-using goods vehicles is the Europe-wide ROADPOL Truck & Bus enforcement week, running 16-22 November 2026 with Italian Police participation. Italy is also reviewing a draft Highway Code reform that would bar goods vehicles above 3.5 t from overtaking in motorway roadworks. It is not yet in force. No verified new abnormal-load permit, escort or route rule was identified for the period.

This edition was prepared after its scheduled release on 2026-11-13T11:00:00.000Z. It covers 2026-W47; the publication date above records the delayed release.

## Lead reports

### ROADPOL Truck and Bus enforcement week: Italian Police check tachographs, driving and rest times, loads and vehicle condition (Italy)

Italian Police will take part in the European Truck and Bus operation coordinated by ROADPOL from Monday 16 to Sunday 22 November 2026. Checks focus on tachographs, driving and rest times, loads and vehicle condition, with particular attention to heavy goods vehicles. This is an industry report (Trasporti Italia) on the campaign.

**Category:** Operational development  
**Where:** Italy, as a participant in the ROADPOL Truck and Bus campaign. The source does not specify roads or locations.  
**Affected vehicles:** Professional goods and passenger transport, with particular attention to heavy goods vehicles. Tachograph-using goods vehicles from 3.5 t are covered by the checks. The source states no exact weight threshold.  
**When:** 16 November 2026 to 22 November 2026

**Impact:** A higher likelihood of roadside inspections in Italy during the week. Tachograph, driving and rest-time, load-securing or vehicle-condition infringements can lead to fines, prohibitions and delays to delivery and ferry schedules. Abnormal-load operators should expect their documents, load securing and vehicle condition to be checked as well; the source does not say whether abnormal transports are specifically targeted.

**Recommended action:** Before departure, check tachograph calibration and data downloads, driver card and record completeness, compliance with driving and rest times, and load securing and vehicle condition. Brief drivers on Italy-bound trips about the enforcement week and allow extra time for roadside checks.

**Exemptions/conditions:** None stated in the source.

*Source: [Trasporti Italia](https://www.trasporti-italia.com/camion/controlli-polizia-mezzi-pesanti-dal-16-al-22-novembre/1523438/) — Industry report — not an official authority notice*

## Operator checklist

- Italy: Before departure, check tachograph calibration and data downloads, driver card and record completeness, compliance with driving and rest times, and load securing and vehicle condition. Brief drivers on Italy-bound trips about the enforcement week and allow extra time for roadside checks.

## Sources

- [Trasporti Italia](https://www.trasporti-italia.com/camion/controlli-polizia-mezzi-pesanti-dal-16-al-22-novembre/1523438/)

## Next EU Oversize Weekly

Friday, 20 November 2026 at 12:00 CET.
